title: The providers' app credentials, as the root broker keeps them
description: GET /api/v1/server/integrations lists the Google, Microsoft and Dropbox application sections of root's integrations file, and the separate applications of the narrower account levels (microsoft_nosend, microsoft_drafts, microsoft_read, dropbox_app_folder), with root's browser_setup switch. POST /api/v1/server/integrations/set {provider, fields} has the broker write one provider's section; POST /api/v1/server/integrations/clear {provider} removes it. A secret is accepted only in a set request and is never returned. A change is in effect only when the reply arrives; 503 outcome_uncertain means it may or may not have been written, and nothing is retried. Refusals are fixed codes shared with root's admin integrations CLI: browser_setup_disabled (root's switch is off), host_busy (host maintenance holds the lock; nothing was written), integrations_file_invalid (root must repair the file), integration_refused, broker_unavailable. Administrator, session and CSRF are required.

provider.description: A section: a provider's own application, which is its full account level, or the application of one of its narrower levels.

client_id.description: Public: it is in every sign-in URL. Absent when root's hand-written value is not token-shaped.

tenant_id.description: Microsoft sections only: the sign-in audience or the organisation's Directory (tenant) ID.

usable.description: Whether every person's daemon uses this section; false sections are ignored there.

source.description: site_admin: the broker wrote exactly these bytes for actor at at; operator: root wrote or changed them.

actor.description: The administrator's GitHub id or root, as the gateway reported it.

browser_setup.description: Root's site.json integrations.browser_setup as host apply published it; while false, set and clear are refused.

fields.description: Exactly the provider's fields: google, dropbox and dropbox_app_folder client_id and client_secret; microsoft, microsoft_nosend, microsoft_drafts and microsoft_read client_id and tenant_id. A Google client id ends in .apps.googleusercontent.com, both Microsoft ids are GUIDs (a single-tenant app: the tenant is the organisation's Directory (tenant) ID, never common, organizations or consumers), and no value may be given twice.
